lines.hook: Most of what you ask an AI doesn't need the most expensive model. So why pay for it?
lines.hello: Ask Claude Code something simple, and a free local model answers. It never leaves your machine.
lines.code: A quick coding task? The local coder takes it.
lines.hard: But a hard debugging question goes to Claude, where your subscription is worth spending.
lines.limit: Hit your session limit, and you keep working on your local models. You don't change a thing.
lines.end: Semantic Router dot net. Open source, one command to install. Stop paying frontier prices for small prompts.
